rows.POTIONS: Antidote. Immediately removes the Poisoned condition.
Coagulate. Immediately removes the Bleeding condition.
Courage. Immediately removes the Frightened condition.
Flaming. When applied to a weapon, increase your Damage Pool by +D4 Fire damage during 5 rounds.
Frenzy. For the next D6 rounds you deal +2D6 damage, but you’re unable to defend in any way.
Heal. You immediately heal D6+2 Wounds.
Regeneration. Heal D10+5 Wounds, at a rate of 1 Wound/round.
Poison. When applied to a weapon, the next successful attack applies the Poisoned (1) condition.
Purge. Immediately removes the Cursed and Sickened conditions.
Rest. Reduce your Exhaustion by D4.
Stoneskin. For the next D10 rooms you have +1 Armor, but your Dodge and Acrobatics Skills are reduced by 10.
Strength. Increase your Endurance and Athletics by +10 for the next D10 rooms.
Vitality. Grants D10 Temporary Toughness. Taking more than one of these while still under the effects of a previous one causes D10 Acid damage.
